title: DOSE-10060 receipt profile on RCO-10060
description: How a cleared read of a DOSE-10060 record is receipted. The receipt object is RCO-10060 receipt v1, unchanged; this profile fixes what each field carries for a medicine read. Version 1.0, 2026-11-14; amended 2026-11-16 (ORDER DOSIDAL-05): one receipt chain per issuing region, each under its own key; the answer hash covers the whole response.

receipt_v1_fields.id: Receipt identifier. It names its chain: rco-dosidal:<chain>:<uuid>. An identifier without a chain name (rco-dosidal:<uuid>) is on the France chain (fr).
receipt_v1_fields.writer: The Dosidal door that served the read
receipt_v1_fields.caller: The resolved agent identity; 'public' for an open read
receipt_v1_fields.subject: The record's subject id
receipt_v1_fields.market: The market the record was read under
receipt_v1_fields.rule_version: standard_version + instance_version + the access rule applied, joined in that order
receipt_v1_fields.answer_hash: SHA-256 of the JCS (RFC 8785) form of the whole response with its "receipt" member removed; nothing else is removed. The response carries the signed record supplied. The only link between receipt and answer. (Receipts before 2026-11-16 hashed the response without receipt, scope, notice and region.)
receipt_v1_fields.prev_hash: Hash of the previous receipt in the same chain
receipt_v1_fields.kid: Receipt key identifier: the key of the receipt's chain, published in the keyring; retired keys stay published

rules: The receipt key and the record key are different keys. Neither signs the other's object.
An as-of read is receipted with the as_of date inside the hashed record, so the receipt binds to the historical answer.
A refused read is receipted too, with the refusal as the answer.
Verifying a receipt needs no credential and writes no receipt; every key in the keyring is accepted.
Each issuing region signs under its own key and writes its own chain; no region needs another to answer. A copy that holds no key has its receipt signed by a region, or answers nothing.
Each chain is checkpointed (its head signed with the chain's key) and mirrored.
A call that may already have written a receipt is never repeated in another region.
